import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the supplied CSV
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')

# One revenue value per region and month
monthly = df.groupby(['region', 'month'], as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
monthly['month'] = pd.to_datetime(monthly['month'])
monthly = monthly.sort_values('month')

# Index each region to its January revenue = 100
jan = monthly[monthly['month'].dt.month == 1].set_index('region')['revenue']
monthly['indexed_revenue'] = monthly.apply(lambda r: r['revenue'] / jan[r['region']] * 100, axis=1)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for region, group in monthly.groupby('region'):
    ax.plot(group['month'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m'), group['indexed_revenue'], marker='o', label=region)

ax.set_title('Revenue by Month (January = 100)')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue index (January = 100)')
ax.set_ylim(0, monthly['indexed_revenue'].max() * 1.1)
ax.legend(title='Region')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
